headline.purpose: Names the active desktop tool workspace.

title.purpose: Separates operational regions without marketing-scale type.

body.purpose: Primary descriptions, forms and status content.

code.purpose: URLs, paths, values and snapshot identifiers.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary command in an operational region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary, #087ff5); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font: 500 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 12%); transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #087ff5) 35%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary command for previews, exports and recovery.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d9dce1); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--background, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #202124); font: 500 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #eceef1); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #087ff5) 35%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Desktop field for paths, URLs and configuration values.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 320px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input, #cfd3d9); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #202124); font: 400 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--muted-foreground, #636871); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, #087ff5); outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #087ff5) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Tool Navigation Item
components.description: Stable tool selector with capability and read state.
components.css: .ds-tool-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr 6px; width: 190px; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--sidebar-accent, #e7effb); color: var(--accent-foreground, #173a63); text-align: left; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-tool-nav:hover { background: var(--muted, #eceef1); } .ds-tool-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #087ff5) 42%, transparent); } .ds-tool-nav:active { transform: scale(.985); } .ds-tool-glyph { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; place-items: center; border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #087ff5) 11%, var(--card, #fff)); color: var(--primary, #087ff5); font: 750 11px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tool-nav strong, .ds-tool-nav small { display: block; } .ds-tool-nav strong { font: 600 13px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tool-nav small { color: var(--muted-foreground, #636871); font: 400 11px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tool-nav i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success, #25a95b); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Short text-backed scan or precedence state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 20px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #087ff5) 10%, transparent); color: var(--primary, #087ff5); font: 600 11px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Source Ledger
components.description: The signature provenance track for configuration precedence.
components.html:
1. 用户级 · C:\Users\demo\.npmrc优先级 30 · 被覆盖
  2. 环境变量 · NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY优先级 40 · 最终生效
components.css: .ds-ledger { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; color: var(--foreground, #202124); } .ds-ledger::before { position: absolute; top: 12px; bottom: 12px; left: 4px; width: 1px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #087ff5) 68%, var(--border, #d9dce1)); content: ''; } .ds-ledger li { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 6px 0 6px 20px; } .ds-ledger li::before { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 0; width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--primary, #087ff5); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--card, #fff); content: ''; } .ds-ledger li[data-effective='true']::before { background: var(--primary, #087ff5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #087ff5) 12%, transparent); } .ds-ledger b { font: 600 12px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ledger small { color: var(--muted-foreground, #636871); font: 400 11px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Inspector Section
components.description: Context summary for sources, plans, recovery and errors.
components.html:
来源概览5 条轨迹

已读取 3 项配置
components.css: .ds-inspector { width: 256px; padding: 16px; border-block: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgb(32 33 36 / 10%)); background: var(--inspector, rgb(249 250 251 / 92%)); color: var(--foreground, #202124); font: 400 12px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-inspector header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-inspector strong { font-weight: 650; } .ds-inspector span, .ds-inspector p { color: var(--muted-foreground, #636871); }

narrative.overview:
MirrorIt 像一张安静、可信的本机配置账本：界面先解释值从哪里来，再允许用户采取动作。冷雾浅色面与石墨深色面保持低噪声，系统蓝只标记主操作、当前选择和来源路径；半透明只用于标题栏、导航和检查器等结构层，不覆盖需要精确阅读的配置内容。

布局服务于长期桌面操作而不是展示。信息密度紧凑但不拥挤，来源优先级、覆盖关系、预览、快照和恢复始终形成连续的安全叙事。Apple 式原则体现在克制材质、清晰层级和自然反馈中，同时保留 Windows 用户熟悉的控件、键盘顺序和操作效率。
keyCharacteristics: 冷雾与石墨双主题，单一系统蓝承担交互信号。
三栏桌面骨架，中央来源账本是视觉与任务中心。
细分隔线、紧凑圆角、极少阴影，内容面保持哑光清晰。
配置值使用等宽字体，长路径和 URL 截断但不破坏布局。
所有写入动作都与预览、快照和恢复状态相邻。

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: 系统蓝只用于当前选择、主要命令、焦点和来源路径，不把整块内容面染成蓝色。

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: 成功、警告和错误必须同时包含图标或文字，不能只依赖颜色。

rules.name: The Desktop Scale Rule
rules.body: 工作区不使用宣传页式超大标题；标题在 20px 封顶，结构由空间和位置建立。

rules.name: The Zero Tracking Rule
rules.body: 中文界面、按钮、导航和代码值保持零字距，不使用负字距压缩内容。

rules.name: The Matte Content Rule
rules.body: 配置、差异和来源轨迹所在的中央内容面不使用模糊、玻璃或装饰阴影。

dos: Do 先呈现来源与最终生效值，再呈现连接检查和写入操作。
Do 让主要动作、状态和恢复路径在浅色与深色主题中都可扫描。
Do 使用 Lucide 图标、明确文字和稳定控件尺寸表达熟悉的桌面命令。
Do 在减少动态、减少透明度和高对比偏好下保留完整层级。
donts: Don't 把页面区段包装为一组浮动卡片或在卡片中嵌套卡片。
Don't 使用大面积单色、渐变光球、装饰插画或宣传页式巨型标题。
Don't 复制 Apple 商标、品牌资产、受限字体或 macOS 窗口控件。
Don't 用颜色代替状态文字，也不要让视觉顺序与 DOM 焦点顺序分离。
Don't 在日志、导出、来源轨迹或截图示例中暴露凭据。
